fb_text:
New guy's first week. Locked gate. He calls you — again.

That used to be my whole day. Gate codes, contact names, which door, what was done last visit. Every answer lived in my head, so every question became a phone call.

Now my crew texts FieldNotes and gets the answer back in seconds. Gate code, visit history, notes from the last stop — it's all in there because their own notes built it.

He's through the gate and working. My phone never rang.

I run a commercial plant service in Atlanta — 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area — and I built FieldNotes for my own crew first. Then I made it for every owner who's still the walking gate-code database.
